set.body: From the review of 5b3cfbe74. The prompt says flagged rows are on screen at that moment, which overstates row-granular presence; reword at the next prompt revision (which needs a new freeze). Fireworks has returned 429 in earlier rounds and each request has one attempt; consider a documented retry-on-429 policy or another route for future rounds.
set.title: S3c-4 follow-up: prompt wording on presence and 429 resilience
